svg.title: Blue lightning dragon asset contact sheet
Blue lightning dragon head
svg.desc: A right-facing sapphire dragon with sculpted reptilian armor, swept ivory-blue horns, an ice-blue slit eye, nostrils, and a fanged jaw. White lightning crosses its neck. The left connection spans y 28 to 72 with lightning at y 50.

svg.title: Blue lightning dragon body
svg.desc: Glossy sapphire scales, ice-blue dorsal spines, and branching white lightning. Repeats horizontally; connections span y 28 to 72, with lightning at y 50.

svg.title: Blue lightning dragon tail
svg.desc: An armored sapphire tail tapering left to an icy spear point, with white lightning. Its right edge connects to the body from y 28 to 72 and lightning at y 50.
